_about: Toolchain: the server and formatter lists own their catalog, add, restart and attachment rows; Language help, the Code health gate and timing limits on the Language Servers tab; the tidy-code switch on Formatters. Docker and registry rows moved to Containers & Execution (two groups), next to the rest of the Docker settings.

toolchain-lsp-home.title: Language servers
toolchain-lsp-home.help: The list, adding a server, restarting, and where each one is attached.

toolchain-lsp.title: Language help
toolchain-lsp.help: Error checking, hover tips and autocomplete while you read and write code.

toolchain-code-gate.title: Code health gate
toolchain-code-gate.help: Keep work from moving on while the code still shows problems.

toolchain-lsp-tools.title: Timing and limits
toolchain-lsp-tools.help: How long language servers may take, and how much of this computer they may use.

toolchain-fmt-home.title: Formatters
toolchain-fmt-home.help: The list and adding your own formatter.

toolchain-formatters.title: Tidy code
toolchain-formatters.help: Whether code is tidied automatically. Each formatter's own choices are in its details.

exec-docker-local.title: Docker on this computer
exec-docker-local.help: Which container engine Puppet Master uses, and when the Docker tools show.

exec-docker-registry.title: Docker Hub and other registries
exec-docker-registry.help: Where images are published, and how Puppet Master signs in there.
